# Plan: Complete Backend Setup — Core Features Page-by-Page, Then AI Integration

Build FastAPI backend implementing all frontend pages with Firebase Auth, Firestore (real-time cache), MongoDB (source of truth), and Gemini 2.5 Flash AI. Transaction balance auto-calculated, agent queued as background task (implemented last).

## Steps

1. **Setup project infrastructure** — Create `.env.example` with `FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_PATH`, `MONGODB_URI`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `CORS_ORIGINS`, `SECRET_KEY`; update [requirements.txt](backend/requirements.txt) adding `firebase-admin`, `motor`, `pymongo`, `google-generativeai`, `pydantic==2.5.0`, `python-dotenv`, `Pillow`, `reportlab`, `python-multipart`, `pydantic-settings`; create [config/settings.py](backend/app/config/settings.py) with Pydantic Settings, [config/firebase.py](backend/app/config/firebase.py) with Firestore init, [config/mongodb.py](backend/app/config/mongodb.py) with async Motor client

2. **Define all Pydantic models** — Create `backend/app/models/` with [user.py](backend/app/models/user.py) (UserBase, UserCreate, UserResponse, UserPreferences, UserStats), [transaction.py](backend/app/models/transaction.py) (TransactionBase, TransactionCreate, TransactionResponse, TransactionFilter, TransactionSummary), [goal.py](backend/app/models/goal.py) (GoalBase, GoalCreate, GoalUpdate, GoalResponse with progress calculation), [notification.py](backend/app/models/notification.py) (NotificationBase, NotificationCreate, NotificationResponse, NotificationFilter), [insight.py](backend/app/models/insight.py) (InsightCard, CategoryBreakdown, CategorySummary, SpendingOverview), [utility.py](backend/app/models/utility.py) (DebtEntry, NetWorthData, ReportRequest, ReceiptScanResponse)

3. **Build Authentication system (Login/Signup pages)** — Create [routers/auth.py](backend/app/routers/auth.py) with: POST `/auth/signup` (verify Firebase token, create user doc in Firestore `users/{uid}` with initial balance=0, created_at, preferences), POST `/auth/login` (verify token, return user data), GET `/auth/me` (get current user); create [middleware/auth_middleware.py](backend/app/middleware/auth_middleware.py) with `get_current_user()` dependency verifying Firebase ID tokens; create [utils/firebase_utils.py](backend/app/utils/firebase_utils.py) with Firestore helper functions (get_user, update_user, create_document)

4. **Build Home page backend** — Create [routers/home.py](backend/app/routers/home.py) with: GET `/home/dashboard` (returns balance, recent 4 transactions, AI insight alert, spending overview chart data); create [services/home_service.py](backend/app/services/home_service.py) with `get_dashboard_data()` fetching balance from Firestore user doc, recent transactions from Firestore `users/{uid}/transactions_cache` (last 50 sorted by date), calculate 30-day spending overview by week from MongoDB aggregation, cache spending chart in Firestore for 1 hour; balance auto-calculated as sum of all transactions (income - expenses) and synced to Firestore user doc on every transaction

5. **Build Transactions page backend** — Create [routers/transactions.py](backend/app/routers/transactions.py) with: POST `/transactions` (create in MongoDB `transactions` collection with user_id, update Firestore cache last 50, recalculate balance, trigger background agent), GET `/transactions?page=1&limit=20` (paginated from MongoDB), GET `/transactions/search?q={query}` (search name/category), GET `/transactions/filter?category=&start_date=&end_date=&min_amount=&max_amount=` (filtered query), GET `/transactions/{id}`, DELETE `/transactions/{id}`; create [services/transaction_service.py](backend/app/services/transaction_service.py) with dual-write logic (MongoDB primary, Firestore cache update), balance recalculation, cache sync function; add MongoDB indexes: `{user_id: 1, date: -1}`, `{user_id: 1, category: 1}`, `{user_id: 1, amount: 1}`

6. **Build Goals page backend** — Create [routers/goals.py](backend/app/routers/goals.py) with: POST `/goals` (create goal), GET `/goals` (list all user goals), GET `/goals/{id}` (single goal with progress), PUT `/goals/{id}` (update saved_amount, auto-calculate progress percentage and remaining), DELETE `/goals/{id}`; create [services/goal_service.py](backend/app/services/goal_service.py) with `calculate_progress(saved, target)`, `check_deadline_status(deadline)`, notification trigger on milestone (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%); store in Firestore `users/{uid}/goals/{goal_id}` with fields: title, target_amount, saved_amount, deadline, category, description, created_at, updated_at

7. **Build Insights page backend** — Create [routers/insights.py](backend/app/routers/insights.py) with: GET `/insights/cards` (4 AI insight cards), GET `/insights/category-breakdown` (bar chart with 5 categories), GET `/insights/category-summary` (3 category cards with trends); create [services/insights_service.py](backend/app/services/insights_service.py) using MongoDB aggregation pipelines: `aggregate_by_category()`, `calculate_month_trends()`, `compare_with_previous_month()`; cache computed insights in MongoDB `insights_cache` collection with TTL index (expires after 6 hours), include fields: user_id, month, category_breakdown, trends, generated_at

8. **Build Profile/Account page backend** — Create [routers/profile.py](backend/app/routers/profile.py) with: GET `/profile` (user info + stats), PUT `/profile` (update name, email, phone, avatar), PUT `/profile/preferences` (update dark_mode, notification settings, currency), GET `/profile/stats` (balance, goals count, transactions count); create [services/profile_service.py](backend/app/services/profile_service.py) with `calculate_user_stats()` aggregating from MongoDB transactions count and Firestore goals count; store all in Firestore `users/{uid}` document with nested `preferences` object

9. **Build Notifications page backend** — Create [routers/notifications.py](backend/app/routers/notifications.py) with: GET `/notifications?filter=all|transactions|goals|insights|alerts&page=1` (paginated list), PUT `/notifications/{id}/mark-read`, DELETE `/notifications/{id}`, PUT `/notifications/mark-all-read`; create [services/notification_service.py](backend/app/services/notification_service.py) with `create_notification(user_id, type, title, message)`, `trigger_on_event()` functions for transaction added, goal milestone, budget alert, bill reminder; store in Firestore `users/{uid}/notifications/{notif_id}` with fields: type, title, message, read, created_at, metadata

10. **Build Utilities & Add Goal backend** — Create [routers/utilities.py](backend/app/routers/utilities.py) with: POST `/utilities/manual-transaction` (same as POST /transactions), GET `/utilities/reports?type=monthly|annual&month=&year=` (generate PDF report), GET `/utilities/networth` (calculate assets - liabilities), POST `/utilities/debt` (add debt entry), GET `/utilities/debt` (list debts), PUT `/utilities/debt/{id}` (mark paid), GET `/utilities/export?format=csv|pdf&start_date=&end_date=` (download transactions), POST `/utilities/receipt-scan` (upload image, extract data); create [services/utilities_service.py](backend/app/services/utilities_service.py) with PDF generation using reportlab, CSV export, net-worth calculation from Firestore user doc assets/liabilities fields; store debts in MongoDB `debts` collection with user_id, person_name, amount, type (owed/lent), status, date

11. **Integrate Gemini AI for categorization & insights** — Create [config/gemini.py](backend/app/config/gemini.py) initializing `genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-2.0-flash-exp')`; create [services/ai/gemini_service.py](backend/app/services/ai/gemini_service.py) with functions: `categorize_transaction(name, amount)` (returns category from Food/Bills/Shopping/Travel/Subscriptions/Others), `generate_insights_batch(transactions, goals)` (returns 4 insight cards with analysis), `scan_receipt(image_bytes)` (Gemini Vision extracts merchant, amount, date, items); update transaction service to auto-categorize on creation, insights service to use AI-generated insights, utilities service for receipt OCR

12. **Implement AI Agent system & Hero features** — Create [services/ai/agent_loop.py](backend/app/services/ai/agent_loop.py) with `run_agent_cycle(user_id, trigger_event)` (observe: fetch data, analyze: Gemini prompt, decide: pick action, execute: call tools, store memory, plan: next check); create [services/ai/memory_system.py](backend/app/services/ai/memory_system.py) storing in MongoDB `user_memory` collection (spending_patterns, income_variability, risk_tolerance, past_nudges, preferences); create [services/ai/event_triggers.py](backend/app/services/ai/event_triggers.py) with hooks for new transaction, budget threshold, goal deviation; create [services/ai/hero_features.py](backend/app/services/ai/hero_features.py) with endpoints exposed via [routers/ai_features.py](backend/app/routers/ai_features.py): GET `/ai/micro-decision?purchase_amount=&category=`, GET `/ai/persona-mode`, PUT `/ai/persona-mode` (set persona), GET `/ai/financial-shield`, GET `/ai/daily-journal?date=`, GET `/ai/stability-score`

13. **Setup background task queue (last step)** — Add `rq` and `redis` to requirements; create [services/background/task_queue.py](backend/app/services/background/task_queue.py) with Redis connection and queue setup; create [services/background/tasks.py](backend/app/services/background/tasks.py) with `@job` decorated functions: `run_agent_background(user_id, event)`, `generate_daily_summary(user_id)`, `check_bill_reminders()`; update transaction POST endpoint to queue agent task instead of running inline; create worker startup script [worker.py](backend/worker.py)

14. **Update main.py with all routers & middleware** — In [main.py](backend/app/main.py): import and include routers (auth, home, transactions, goals, insights, profile, notifications, utilities, ai_features), add CORS middleware with Expo origin, add startup event for MongoDB/Firestore/Redis connections, add exception handlers, create GET `/health` and GET `/` endpoints; configure lifespan context manager for proper shutdown

15. **Restructure features.md with complete page mapping** — Rewrite [features.md](backend/features.md) with sections for each frontend page (Login/Signup, Home, Insights, Goals, Profile, Transactions, Notifications, Add Goal, Utilities) listing: **Backend Endpoints** (method + path), **Database Collections** (Firestore/MongoDB), **AI Features** (which Gemini functions), **Non-AI Features** (standard CRUD), **Event Triggers** (what triggers agent); add final sections for Database Schema Overview and API Endpoint Index
